title: Course Module 6 The Diffusion of Emerging Technologies
url: course://Slides/ET Module 6 - The Diffusion of Emerging Technologies FA25.pptx
measurement: Conceptual framework, not a field observation
definition: Rogers five attributes and categories; local innovation decision stages; communication channels; chasm teaching heuristic

title: The state of AI in 2026 On the road to ROI
population: 1,719 survey participants in 97 nations; country GDP weighting; respondent organizations grouped by revenue
definition: Reported scaling of agents in at least one function
claim: 40% in the above USD1 billion revenue subgroup; 22% in the smaller subgroup.
admissible: General agent-scaling signal within this survey
limit: Not a census of firms, not enterprise-wide use or finance chart-review penetration. Case revenue unknown. No October fieldwork.

title: Large Firms With at Least 20 Employees Biggest AI Users
population: US employer businesses in BTOS; sector and national estimates
definition: Any AI in any business function during prior two weeks
admissible: Dated broad-AI background and denominator counterexample
limit: Not an agent or chart-review measure, nor the latest October release. Wording broadened November 17, 2025; do not splice with the old production-only series.

title: MCP joins the Agentic AI Foundation
population: Protocol ecosystem, not an eligible adopter population
definition: MCP becomes a founding AAIF project under Linux Foundation
claim: Vendor-neutral protocol governance provides an ecosystem complement.
limit: Availability, server counts and SDK downloads are not unique organizations, sustained use, security certification or local value.

title: RPS Generative AI Usage Share Work
population: Employed US adults aged 18 to 64 in the nationally representative Real-Time Population Survey
definition: Share reporting generative AI use for their job
admissible: Broader individual-work GenAI context introduced by Jianbo
limit: Not firms, not chart-review agents, not repeated use in a longitudinal cohort. Revisions possible; no uncertainty interval in this packet. Cite Bick, Blandin and Deming via FRED.

title: RPS Generative AI Usage Share Last Week Work
population: Employed US adults aged 18 to 64, same RPS as S4
definition: Share using generative AI on at least one workday in the prior week
admissible: Distinguish reported job use from recent intensity
limit: Same source population as S4, not independent corroboration; no causal explanation or chart-agent prevalence follows.

title: Building effective agents
measurement: Engineering experience, not a diffusion survey

admissible: Dated mechanism and baseline design support
